label: lem:uniform_continuity
title: Uniform continuity on compact sets
statement: If $K$ is a compact set and $f$ is continuous on $K$, then $f$ is uniformly continuous on $K$. In Mathlib this is \texttt{IsCompact.uniformContinuousOn\_of\_continuous}.
proof: This is the Heine--Cantor theorem: continuous functions on compact metric spaces (more generally, compact uniform spaces) are uniformly continuous.
